chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
There are no two believers who unite in a permissible marriage until a caller calls out from the sky, saying: 'Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has married so-and-so to so-and-so.'

And he (peace be upon him) said: 'And two spouses do not separate in a permissible manner until a caller calls out from the sky, saying: 'Indeed, Allah has permitted the separation of so-and-so and so-and-so.''
ai.seo_question: What is the divine role in the marriage and divorce of believers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the metaphysical reality of marriage (Nikah) as a divine decree rather than merely a social contract, reflecting the Shia belief in the cosmic order of relationships. The 'heavenly caller' signifies Allah's direct involvement in the union and separation of spouses, highlighting that marital bonds are sustained by divine will and permission. This concept reinforces the spiritual gravity of marital stability and the sanctity of the family unit in Shia jurisprudence and theology.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There are none from the Believers who are copulating with a Permissible marriage until a Caller Calls out from the sky that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic had Married so and so man to so and so woman’

And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And not two spouses separate in a Permissible way until a Caller Calls from the sky that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Permitted regarding the separation of so and so man from so and so woman’.
en.sarwar: 33. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When two believing people come together by means of lawful marriage a caller from the sky announces, ‘Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has given so and so in marriage to so and so,
and when a wife and husband separate (divorce) in a lawful manner, a caller from the sky announces, ‘Allah has given permission to so and so wife and husband to separate (divorce) from each other/”
